blurb:
Do you believe in the paranormal?

Hosted by professional ghost hunter Dominique Desormeaux of 13 Spirits Paranormal, "Paranormal Investigation – Old Cemetery of Saint Anthony", takes guests on a dark adventure into the mysterious world of ghost hunting.

From 1799 to 1855, St. Anthony’s Cemetery hosted approximately 70,000 burials, many of which were buried in mass graves due to a series of cholera epidemics that struck the city. 

Today, the old cemetery is hidden under two of Montreal’s most beautiful and popular urban parks, Dorchester Park and Canada Place, a favorite spot for paranormal activities in downtown Montreal.
